jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician – Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Are you a hands-on technician who likes fixing things, solving technical problems and working with machines? Would you also like to use your technical skills in an industry that gives plastic a second life? We are looking for an All-round Maintenance Technician to join the technical team. What will you do? You will be part of the technical maintenance team and help keep the recycling plant running safely and reliably. Your work can include: Preventive and corrective maintenance Finding and solving technical problems Mechanical repairs Basic electrical troubleshooting Maintenance on pumps, motors, valves and production equipment Replacing and repairing mechanical components Helping when there is a breakdown Working together with production operators and other technicians Improving the reliability of machines and installations It is a hands-on technical job with plenty of variety. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We want to make the move to the Netherlands worthwhile. You can expect: A Dutch employment contract A competitive salary based on your experience 3200 - 4200 euro gross, per month Additional benefits according to the Dutch employment package A stable, full-time position in an international industrial company Support with your relocation to the Netherlands Help with finding accommodation and arranging practical matters Opportunities to learn, develop and grow within the technical team Functie-eisen You could be a good match if you: Have a background in mechanics, electromechanics, mechatronics, electricity or industrial maintenance Have experience as a maintenance technician, mechanic, electromechanical technician or similar Enjoy practical technical work Have some knowledge of both mechanical and electrical systems Are comfortable working in an industrial environment Can communicate in English Are interested in moving to the Netherlands You don't need to know everything. If you are technically minded, like working with your hands and are willing to learn, we would like ttalk to you. Hier kom je te werken The factory is focused on plastic recycling. Used PET bottles are collected, sorted, cleaned and processed into high-quality recycled plastic material. This material can then be used again for new bottles, packaging, fibres and other products. Instead of plastic becoming waste, the goal is to bring it back into the production cycle. For you as a technician, this means working in a real industrial environment with machinery, production lines, pumps, motors and technical installations that need to keep running every day. Relocation to the Netherlands The position is based in the eastern part of the Netherlands. Moving to another country is a big step, so we help you with the practical side of your relocation. We can support you with: Relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands Finding accommodation Registration and administration Practical arrangements before your move Support after you arrive

The Netherlands | Relocation to the Netherlands Are you an experienced Instrumentation or E&I Technician and interested in taking the next step in the Netherlands? We are looking for experienced E&I Technicians to join the maintenance team at the industrial site in the Netherlands. You will become part of an experienced team of around 18 E&I technicians, ranging from junior to senior level. For this position, we are especially interested in technicians who have a strong background in instrumentation and industrial maintenance. You don't need to know every system or brand, but you should be comfortable working independently in a process industry environment. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A Dutch employment contract A competitive salary based on your experience A long-term assignment at Actemium / LyondellBasell Dutch employment conditions and benefits Support with your relocation to the Netherlands Help with finding suitable accommodation and practical arrangements All necessary PPE and professional tools for the job A professional industrial environment with an experienced E&I team Opportunities to further develop your technical knowledge and experience Before you make the decision to relocate, we will clearly discuss the salary, employment conditions, housing and relocation arrangements, so you know exactly what to expect. Functie-eisen We are looking for someone with around 8 years or more of experience in industrial E&I or instrumentation. Experience with some of the following is a strong advantage: HART communication ValveLink Honeywell DE Calibration and loop testing Control valves Flow, pressure and level instrumentation Motors, switchgear and feeder panels Commissioning and start-up activities Chemical, petrochemical, oil & gas or other process industries Your experience can be more focused on instrumentation than electrical – for this position, that is actually a plus. You are practical, independent and comfortable solving technical problems. You should also: Be ableto communicate well in English Enjoy working in an international team Have a strong focus on safety Be open to relocating to the Netherlands Already have the right to work in the Netherlands/EU without employer sponsorship You don't need to match every single technical requirement. If you have a solid instrumentation background and recognise yourself in most of the work above, we would still like to hear from you. Hier kom je te werken This is an opportunity to use your experience at a large industrial production site while becoming part of an established E&I maintenance team. We will support you with the practical side of relocating to the Netherlands, so you don't have to arrange everything on your own.

jobs.occupation: Ergotherapist (Occupational Therapist) – Germany International Applicants Welcome (Ergotherapeut/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for motivated and compassionate Ergotherapists (Occupational Therapists) from abroad who are interested in building their professional careers in Germany. This is an excellent opportunity for qualified professionals who are willing to relocate to Germany and work in a modern healthcare environment.Successful candidates will support patients in improving their independence, mobility, motor skills, cognitive abilities, and quality of life through individualized therapeutic interventions.International applicants are welcome to apply. Guidance regarding professional recognition, German language learning, visa procedures, and relocation may be provided, depending on the employer's arrangements.Key Responsibilities- Assess patients' physical, cognitive, psychological, and functional abilities.- Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.- Provide therapeutic interventions to improve daily living skills and independence.- Support patients recovering from injuries, illnesses, neurological conditions, or developmental challenges.- Monitor treatment progress and document therapeutic outcomes.- Collaborate with physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals.- Educate patients and their families on therapeutic exercises and everyday activities.- Maintain accurate patient records and comply with German healthcare standards.Requirements- Completed qualification or degree in Ergotherapy/Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution.- Relevant professional experience is an advantage; motivated recent graduates may also be considered.- Willingness to relocate to Germany.- Willingness to learn German and achieve the language level required for professional recognition and employment.- Motivation to complete the professional recognition process in Germany.- Strong communication skills, empathy, patience, and a patient-focused approach.- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.Opportunities for International ApplicantsDepending on the employer and individual circumstances, support may include:- Guidance with recognition of foreign professional qualifications.- Assistance with German language courses.- Information and support regarding visa and work permit procedures.- Relocation guidance and help with settling in Germany.- Assistance with accommodation arrangements, where available.- Opportunities for long-term professional development.What We Offer- Employment opportunities in Germany's healthcare sector.- A professional and supportive working environment.- Opportunities to develop clinical skills and gain international work experience.- Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, location, and employer.- Potential long-term career opportunities in Germany.How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit:- An updated CV in English or German.- Copies of educational certificates and professional qualifications.- Evidence of relevant work experience, if available.- German language certificates, if available.- Information about current country of residence and willingness to relocate.Take the next step in your career and start your journey as an Ergotherapist in Germany!International candidates are encouraged to apply. Employment is subject to the applicable professional recognition, language, immigration, and work authorization requirements in Germany.Important information for applicants from abroadIn Germany, the profession of Ergotherapeut/in is regulated. Before working under the professional title, applicants generally need recognition of their foreign qualification and authorization to use the professional title.- Qualification recognition: The responsible authority depends on the German federal state where you intend to work.- German language: Employers and recognition authorities may require German proficiency. B2 is a useful target, although the exact requirements can vary.- Visa and relocation: Requirements depend on your nationality, qualifications, and circumstances.- Job opportunities: Hospitals, rehabilitation centres, private therapy practices, care facilities, and paediatric therapy centres may recruit international professionals.

jobs.occupation: Truck Driver (CE) for national long-distance routes – Germany (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
jobs.description: Are you living in the EU and ready for a secure job from Monday to Friday? Then this is your gateway to a well-paid job in Germany’s transport sector. I am looking for motivated drivers from all backgrounds. Whether you’re from Italy, Spain, Romania, or anywhere else – if you are living in the EU, I would love to hear from you.Your Tasks- Ensure smooth and reliable transport handling on national long-distance routes * Load and unload as needed, inspecting and securing cargo properly * Handle all necessary freight documentation * Maintain the cleanliness of your vehicle, inside and out * Plan routes and navigate while strictly following driving and rest timesYour Profile- EU Category CE driver’s license with Code 95 and a valid driver card * Legal residence in an EU country * Technical understanding of your vehicle * Highly reliable with driving and rest time regulations * Basic knowledge of German or English Your Benefits- Salary starting from €3,000 gross per month plus per diems (single/double) * Full-time, permanent contract directly with the German employer from day one * National long-distance routes – you only drive Monday to Friday * Open truck (partly tarpaulin) in a modern fleet, including e-trucks * My personal support with your relocation and apartment search * Edenred Ticket Plus Card, company pension plan, and private accident insurance * New workwear annually and bicycle/e-bike leasing * Regular, paid training (ADR, forklift, ECO training)About hello jobshello jobs is an international recruitment agency with a passion for connecting people. We support drivers from all over the world on their way to stable, long-term employment in Germany. Our multilingual team knows the industry and is here to guide you every step of the way. We welcome applications from people of all genders, nationalities and backgrounds. Your motivation and skills are what matter most.
